name: Odyssey Ark
summary: Sound and a paired remote directly in your Nook, with live monitor read-back.
capabilities: Discovers Samsung monitors on the local network
Reads identity and audio state directly over local HTTP
Changes volume and mute with identity checks and read-back
Pairs a local Samsung remote and stores its token in Keychain
Sends explicitly selected remote navigation keys without retry
Exports reviewed audio actions through the shared plugin SDK
